name: Berlin Fernsehturm
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: Berlin’s Fernsehturm: long tapered concrete needle, a 32 m faceted silver sphere centered at 212 m, twin observation window belts, evacuation collars and a red-white broadcast antenna. The 32 m sphere and 212 m center use the government technical sheet. OSM component heights conflict: the sphere is tagged 205–235 m and an antenna part reaches 374 m; those heights are not used. The current tip is modeled at 368.03 m. Pedestal flare, emergency collars, antenna diameters and cladding/window segmentation are estimates. The adjacent low entrance pavilion and folded roofs are excluded. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
